raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 28 re-delivered rows with record_version 2 that duplicate txn_ids already present at version 1. The silver step filters on status before resolving versions, so when a txn has both a POSTED version 1 and a POSTED version 2, both survive. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id and then apply the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE r.rn = 1 AND r.status = 'POSTED';"}}
